c1.note: The Q3 2026 release dated Oct 28, 2026 covers the quarter ended Sept 30, 2026.

c3.note: Release shows revenue of $127.577B (shown as $127.6B in the headline) and CNBC reports $127.58B.

c5.note: The release table lists total revenues of $102,346M for Q3 2025.

c6.note: The release and the CFO both cite the 13th consecutive quarter of double-digit growth.

c7.note: The call states operating income of $40.6B, and 31.8% of $127.577B is about $40.58B.

c8.note: The call states operating income increased 30%.

c9.note: No passage shows the figure directly; it matches the reported Q3 2025 operating income and the 30% growth rate.

c10.note: The call states an operating margin of 31.8%.

c11.note: The release says $26.2B available to common stockholders, and CNBC reports $26.17B.

c13.note: CNBC reports net income of $34.98B for the prior-year quarter.

c14.note: The release and CNBC both give EPS of $2.12, down from $2.87.

c15.note: CNBC reports the year-ago EPS as $2.87.

c16.note: Release table shows OI&E of $12,759M a year ago vs $(8,221)M in Q3 2026; the 'mark-to-market' driver in variant B is supported by the equity securities loss footnote.

c17.note: Release footnote attributes Q3 OI&E to an $8.7B loss on equity securities (unrealized and realized), consistent with mark-to-market losses.

c18.note: Footnote states net effect of the loss on equity securities of $8.7 billion in Q3 2026.

c19.note: CNBC cites an $8.66B loss in equity holdings and mentions SpaceX and Anthropic stakes, though the stakes are tied to Q2 gains rather than explicitly to the Q3 loss.

c20.note: No passage shows management attributing the decline primarily to unrealized SpaceX losses; the release only cites losses on equity securities generally.

c21.note: CNBC reports $2.67 adjusted EPS vs $3.02 expected per LSEG.

c24.note: CNBC says the company posted its first top-and-bottom-line miss in nearly four years.

c25.note: CNBC says shares slumped more than 10% after the report, and its headline says Alphabet sinks 10%.

c26.note: Release states Cloud revenue rose 103% to $30.7B, with the segment table showing $30,709M vs $15,157M.

c28.note: Segment table shows Google Cloud revenue of $15,157M for the quarter ended Sept 30, 2025.

c29.note: $15.157B is the Q3 2025 figure; Q3 2026 Google Cloud revenue was $30.709B.

c30.note: Release states growth was led by GCP across enterprise AI infrastructure and solutions, with TPU systems sales a meaningful contributor.

c31.note: Release states Google Services revenues up 11% to $96.3B; segment table shows $96,302M.

c32.note: CNBC reports search revenue up 12% to $63.35B vs $64.96B estimate; the filing table shows $63,350M.

c34.note: CNBC reports negative FCF of $9.07B vs $2.70B expected; the earnings call confirms FCF of -$9.1B.

c35.note: CNBC says analysts expected $2.70B. The sign is ambiguous: CNBC's wording 'fell much further than the $2.70 billion' suggests -$2.70B, though it could read as positive. Treated as a negative expectation.

c36.note: CNBC reports Q3 capex of $51.36B vs $55.09B expected.

c37.note: CNBC states the $55.09B analyst expectation for Q3 capex.

c38.note: CFO said full-year 2026 capex guidance of $195-205B remains unchanged.

c39.note: CNBC says guidance was lifted to $195-205B in Q2 from $190B.

c40.note: Direct quote from CFO Ashkenazi; the call transcript confirms the same wording.

c42.note: CNBC wording matches: annual capex expected to top $200B before exceeding $300B in 2027.

c43.note: CFO confirms long-term debt of $125.1B; CNBC gives the $21.6B prior-year figure and ~479% increase. 125.1/21.6 is about 5.79x, i.e. +479%.

c44.note: Release quotes Pichai: 'now on a half-trillion dollar revenue run rate.'

c46.note: Press release quotes Pichai: year-over-year query growth rate highest in last five years.

c47.note: Release states nearly 32 billion tokens per minute, more than four times a year ago.

c48.note: Release says Gemini app reached one billion users, fastest-growing product in Google's history.

c49.note: Release: surpassed 150 million YouTube Music and Premium subscribers including trials.

c50.note: 10-Q confirms $0.22 dividend payable December 14, 2026 to holders of record December 7.

c51.note: Release confirms $15.63 per share quarterly dividend on Series A and B mandatory convertible preferred stock.

c52.note: Release labels Q3 2026 highlights unaudited; Q3 is the latest reported quarter as of Nov 11, with Q4 not yet reported. The 'dollar figures rounded' variant is plausible but unsupported by the passages.

c54.note: No passage directly addresses it, but the release states figures like $127.6 billion in rounded form and financial tables are in millions; generic and low-stakes.

c55.note: Net income available to common stockholders is by definition after preferred dividends; release mentions mandatory convertible preferred dividends.

c56.note: Release reconciles GAAP operating cash flow to non-GAAP free cash flow and lists it among non-GAAP measures.

c57.note: Q4 call referenced for further 2027 capex details; Alphabet historically reports Q4 in late Jan/early Feb, though no passage gives a date, so this is an expectation.

c2.note: The 10-Q covers the quarter ended 2026-09-30. The EDGAR index shows a 2026-10-29 filing date, and this is the latest reported quarter. The saved 10-Q page itself shows no filing date.

c12.note: Both the earnings release and the 10-Q show Q3 net income of $26,468M. Net income available to common stockholders is $26,170M, about $26.2B.

c22.note: The saved CNBC page gives $3.02 expected EPS and does not mention MarketBeat or $3.01. I did not search for the MarketBeat reports. Analyst consensus is context, not the reported result.

c6.note: Q3 2026 release (SEC Ex. 99.1) says '13th consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth'.

c23.note: Release shows revenue of $127,577M. CNBC reports $127.58B vs the $128.22B LSEG estimate, a miss.

c26.note: Google Cloud revenue was $30,709M vs $15,157M a year earlier, up about 103%. The release states 103% to $30.7B.

c32.note: Search & other was $63,350M vs $56,567M, up 12%. CNBC: below the $64.96B estimate.

c52.note: Release tables are marked 'unaudited'. Q3 2026 (reported Oct 28) is the latest quarter as of 2026-11-11.

c56.note: Release lists free cash flow among its non-GAAP financial measures.
